## SplitButton.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: The menu rows shown when the chevron is pressed.
- `variant` :: The visual style of both halves.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The text colour. Defaults to `text-inverse` on dark variants, `text-primary` on light ones.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the outer corners.
- `surface` :: The surface of the menu that opens from the chevron. @default 'glass'
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the primary label.
- `placement` :: Where the menu opens relative to the whole control.
- `menuLabel` :: The accessible name of the chevron button.
- `loading` :: Shows a spinner on the primary action and blocks it. The menu stays available.
- `children` :: The primary action's label.
- `disabled` :: Blocks both halves: the action and the menu.

## split-button.ts

### `interface SplitButtonItem`

One row in a SplitButton menu.

- `label` :: The row's text.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `onSelect` :: Called when the row is chosen by click, Enter or Space. The menu closes afterwards.
- `disabled` :: Dims the row and removes it from keyboard navigation.
- `danger` :: Draws the row in the danger ink, for destructive choices.

### `type SplitButtonPlacement`

Where the menu opens relative to the whole split button.
